items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: A fellow, old man those days, used to be a very popular ragtime piano player called Luckey Roberts. He used to (inaudible), he used to play those swanky private parties for the rich people.

ctx.x: I was -- hang around all day, and before I knew, I was speaking English. That I do know, because when -- no way for me to speak Spanish then. No Spanish people around here. You can hardly see one. So I have to either talk English or die.

So I begin to get acquainted with those guys. So I remember very -- my first job. A fellow, old man those days, used to be a very popular ragtime piano player called Luckey Roberts. He used to (inaudible), he used to play those swanky private parties for the rich people.

items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Your first job was with Lucky Roberts... Lucky Roberts, I played some of these private parties for the rich people.

ctx.x: Since this is the last interview, I want to get into (unintelligible) things. Your first job was with Lucky Roberts. Can you remember anything about him? What kind of person was he when you worked with him? What did you do with him?

Lucky Roberts, I played some of these private parties for the rich people. He used to play a whole lot of them, sometimes four piece, sometimes five pieces. You know what I mean. He was a very nice man, because -- oh, man, he was a short guy. He always used to be racing all the time.
